summary: PPL Electric Utilities Corp. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into an underwriting agreement for the issuance of $500 million First Mortgage Bonds (5.75% Series due 2056) under its Indenture. The bonds are secured by a lien on substantially all of PPL Electric's distribution and transmission properties. Proceeds will be used to repay short-term debt and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No independent board recommendation or advisor is noted. The transaction closed on May 15, 2026. There is no risk-arb or special-situation angle; watch for ordinary interest-rate movements.
